verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a human-facing web portal (bizfile Online), a bulk data mention, and downloadable lists, none of which is a documented API. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the portal sits behind bot management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
